rules: NO transparent backgrounds in sticky headers, overlays, or any surface over content. Use solid bg-white.
Hover/Active states must have clear contrast. Active sidebar items must have a distinct left-border or background highlight.

layouts.screen_structure: Flex column full height. Sticky Header -> Sticky Filter Row -> Flex Row (Sidebar + Content).
layouts.header: Padding top for safe area. Flex row for delivery timer + share icon. Full width search bar underneath. MUST have solid bg-white with z-50.
layouts.filters: Horizontal scroll, gap-3, padding-x-4, padding-y-2 border-b border-gray-100.
layouts.sidebar_left: Width 24%. Border-right border-gray-200. Background gray-50. Vertical scroll for categories.

grids.product_grid: Two-column grid (numColumns=2). Gap 12px. Equal width columns.
grids.product_card: Flex column, relative layout. Image on top (aspect-square, ~100px height). Absolute add button bottom right or standard action row at bottom.

motion.scroll_animation: Implement dual-scroll synchronization. Right SectionList drives left FlatList. Use onViewableItemsChanged on the right product grid to detect which category is active in view, and automatically scroll the left sidebar to the corresponding active index.
motion.header_collapse: Optional Animated.ScrollView for header to subtly hide search bar on scroll down, keeping delivery timer strictly sticky.

visual enhancers.shadows: Subtle shadow-sm on product cards. Header needs shadow-sm to distinguish from scrolling content below.
visual enhancers.badges: Delivery time badge needs light background (e.g., bg-emerald-50) with emerald icon.

accessibility.guidelines: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Use descriptive roles for buttons.

media.image_handling: Product images must have aspect-ratio 1, resizeMode='contain'.
media.placeholders: Use default gray View (bg-gray-100) if image is loading.

instructions_to_main_agent: Target file is exactly /app/frontend/app/category/[id].js (Use .js extension, NEVER .tsx per explicit instructions).
Layout Construction: Create a solid white sticky header with Delivery Timer (top left), Share (top right), and Search bar (full width bottom). Ensure z-index is high to prevent overlap.
Below the search bar, add a horizontally scrollable filter row for 'Sort', 'Brand', etc. pills.
Main Content Split: Use a flex row. Left side width is 24% for the narrow vertical category sidebar. Right side width is 76% for the two-column product grid.
Update src/components/product-card.js: Ensure it holds the Image, Title, Delivery min estimate row (⚡ X mins), Price, and an Add/Quantity toggle matching dense e-commerce UI.

Scroll Animation Logic: Implement right-to-left list synchronization. Map right-side scroll position to left-side active category using React Native's `onViewableItemsChanged` on the right-side list, updating the active state of the left category sidebar.
Ensure the bottom navigation persists and remains unchanged.
DO NOT invent mock data for reviews or nutrition labels. Use existing data mapped from the context.
Ensure all backgrounds that overlap scrolling content are SOLID (bg-white), strictly no transparency.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use raw centered layouts for text.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Solid fills are mandatory to avoid content clash.
Always apply layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (button, input, tab, etc).
Adhere to mobile-first precise geometry. Use exact spacing (gap-3, p-4) to match dense, high-utility subcategory design (like fast-commerce interfaces).
